        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>QA_CHECK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SO" name="Support Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UPDATE_CALENDARS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CREATE_FOLDERS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UPLOAD_DOCUMENTS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ADVISE_MEMBERS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>PRODUCE_MINUTES</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SEND_MINUTES</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UPDATE_RECORDS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_CM" name="Committee Members">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>READ_DOCUMENTS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>HOLD_MEETING</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:task id="CREATE_FOLDERS" name="Create meeting folders for each meeting" />
    <bpmn:task id="UPLOAD_DOCUMENTS" name="Upload all appropriate documents to the system" />
    <bpmn:task id="ADVISE_MEMBERS" name="Advise Committee Members to read related documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="READ_DOCUMENTS" name="Read all related documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="HOLD_MEETING" name="Hold the meeting" />
    <bpmn:task id="PRODUCE_MINUTES" name="Produce the minutes including any action points for each Committee Member" />
    <bpmn:task id="QA_CHECK" name="Conduct a QA check on the minutes" />
    <bpmn:task id="SEND_MINUTES" name="Send the minutes to all Committee Members" />
    <bpmn:task id="UPDATE_RECORDS" name="Update all departmental records" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END" name="Departmental records updated" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="FINALIZE_DATES" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="FINALIZE_DATES" targetRef="UPDATE_CALENDARS" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="READ_DOCUMENTS" targetRef="HOLD_MEETING" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="HOLD_MEETING" targetRef="PRODUCE_MINUTES" />
